answer: Each identity escrows 24 POA for 12 epochs and publishes a quartz commitment to its funding parent. At every zenith checkpoint, 7 randomly selected established peers verify parent links and signed work receipts; 5 approvals activate one vote. If a cluster adds fake identity k, its required bond is 24*k^2 POA, so the next fake costs 24*(2*k-1) more than the prior one. The ledger thread records draws, receipts, and links; mismatches slash the cluster and quarantine it for 6 epochs.
